attributes.name: raise_and_hold_arm
attributes.text: An arm is raised to a position and held still before lowering.
attributes.definition: The arm lifts to a target position, pauses there with little motion, then lowers; there is no repeated stroke during the hold.

attributes.name: arm_extends_forward
attributes.text: An arm straightens forward away from the body.
attributes.definition: The elbow extends so the hand moves forward far in front of the shoulder.

attributes.name: arms_raise_overhead
attributes.text: The arms rise until the hands are above the head.
attributes.definition: One or both hands move upward past the top of the head.

attributes.name: fast_arm_swing_arc
attributes.text: An arm swings quickly through a wide arc.
attributes.definition: The hand travels a long curved path at high speed, driven from the shoulder.

attributes.name: wrist_twist
attributes.text: The hand turns about the forearm axis.
attributes.definition: The wrist rotates so the thumb and hand tip change direction around the forearm, with little arm travel.

attributes.name: head_rotates_sideways
attributes.text: The head turns or tilts to the side.
attributes.definition: The head joint rotates left or right around the neck, or tilts toward one shoulder.

attributes.name: downward_press
attributes.text: A hand or foot pushes sharply downward.
attributes.definition: The hand or foot moves down quickly with force toward a low point and stops.

attributes.name: pull_toward_body
attributes.text: A hand pulls back toward the person's own body.
attributes.definition: After reaching out, the hand moves sharply back toward the person's own torso as a main phase of the action.

attributes.name: hands_converge
attributes.text: The two hands move toward each other and come together.
attributes.definition: The distance between the two hands shrinks during the main phase, ending with the hands close or touching.

attributes.name: hands_separate
attributes.text: The two hands start together and move apart.
attributes.definition: The hands begin close together and the distance between them grows during the main phase.

attributes.name: hand_moves_onto_head
attributes.text: The hands move to the head and settle there.
attributes.definition: The hands travel to the head and their last position on the head is reached by moving downward or backward onto it.

attributes.name: hand_moves_off_head
attributes.text: The hands start at the head and move up or forward away from it.
attributes.definition: The hands begin on the head and the main motion carries them up or forward away from the head.

attributes.name: back_and_forth_oscillation
attributes.text: A body part moves back and forth repeatedly along a short path.
attributes.definition: The hand or head moves to and fro along roughly the same short line several times.

attributes.name: circular_hand_path
attributes.definition: The hand joint follows a closed, roughly round path, repeated.
